controlTower.intro: Design owner of the Control Tower at OOCL — a multi-service control plane that manages agent fleets, exposes live status, and gates actions through human approval. Every change is versioned; every action is attributable.
controlTower.openSource: Locally runnable simplification of the same pattern: Java 21 and React, approval gates, agent chains, and a real concurrency harness.
controlTower.note: Validated end-to-end on a Docker/Podman compose stack — control-tower UI, core services, shims, MySQL and Mongo. An always-up registry/forwarder removed a boot-time blocking failure in A2A card fetch: dispatch now fails fast instead of blocking worker boot.

decomposer.body: Designed the job-decomposer library in the platform scheduler. A job is decomposed recursively into tasks and work units across N levels, then dispatched over asynchronous messaging. The heartbeat loop keeps dispatching, respects queue limits, and applies backpressure so large or continuously loaded jobs do not stall. Workers scale from configuration or available resources; job definitions persist in the scheduler and dispatch through its processing API.

observability.body: Production observability on Rancher-managed Kubernetes: Grafana and Prometheus, Azure Monitor, Elasticsearch/Filebeat, Metabase. p50/p95 latency instrumentation, load and concurrency E2E, and rollout verification are part of delivery, not an afterthought.

projects.name: aria-conductor
projects.description: Java 21 + React 19 control tower for agent chains. Found and fixed a TOCTOU governance bypass; built the load and concurrency harness.
projects.cvDescription: Designed and built a multi-service control tower: Java 21/Spring Boot backend, React 19/TypeScript dashboard, Node/TypeScript MCP server, MariaDB/H2, Docker/Podman, and per-agent OpenSandbox containers. Implemented governance and operator workflows: task approval gates, versioned knowledge, BA→Dev→QA agent chains, live run status, kanban, and activity timeline. Found a TOCTOU governance bypass under concurrent opposing approvals (5/8 double-commits); replaced read-check-write with an atomic conditional UPDATE, reducing double approvals to 0/8 with clean 409s for losers. Fixed a 500/rollback-poisoning failure that fired 12/12 under mixed load; built the load and concurrency E2E harness (100-read burst p95 ≈0.9 s, 16-client mixed load errorRate=0, 6× pool saturation zero 5xx) plus Playwright UI coverage.
